meta.description: Imports and cleans MaxQuant, DIA-NN, and mzML data while preserving quantitative and missingness contracts.
meta.audit_type: directed final pass: exact-source archived regressions, fresh edge checks, and every packaged example
meta.execution_note: exact_source_checks.json records six archived executions and four fresh checks against the source commit, including a generated mzXML reader check. The QFeatures example was verified in a bounded clean R process with a process-local teardown guard and receipt.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: The final pass adds no unsupported biological-performance claim and preserves the prior evidence-based FDR, zero, and missingness guidance.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill remains a technical import and diagnostic guide, not a clinical or statistical-decision workflow.

methodological_ground.detail: Corrected TMT reporter channels, not the single group-total Intensity value, now form the documented import matrix; the associated computation boundary remains explicit.

code_usability.detail: All exact-source Python blocks and all four packaged examples completed. QFeatures completed 1500 x 8 with no -Inf and a clean guarded process exit.

functional_suitability.note: Label-free, TMT, DIA-NN, mzML, and QFeatures routes now have explicit, correct decision boundaries.

reliability.note: All-flags-absent input fails clearly; all supported input routes protect zero and confidence contracts.

performance_context.note: All added operations are linear imports or small read-only examples.

agent_usability.note: Quant-family selection, errors, row accounting, and routing now agree.

human_usability.note: TMT and QFeatures pitfalls have direct recoveries and runnable entry points.

security.note: All Skill paths read user data without mutating it.

maintainability.note: Every documented import format now has a packaged executable example.

agent_specific.note: The quantification, inference, and differential-abundance stop conditions remain explicit.
